architecture.mechanism: Global optimization of magnet shape and layout using differential evolution algorithms to maximize state separation in magnetic field sensing.
architecture.intervention: Replace mechanical steering column bearings or driveline universal joints with a non-contact magnetic position sensor system designed via differential evolution to monitor shaft alignment and vibration modes without physical friction.
architecture.expected_effect: Elimination of speed-dependent steering vibration and driveline humming by removing mechanical contact points that generate resonance, while maintaining steering precision through high-resolution magnetic tracking.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the modified steering and driveline system on a dynamometer from 25MPH to 75MPH under acceleration; failure is confirmed if vibration amplitude exceeds 0.5g or humming sound pressure level exceeds 45dB at the driver's ear.
